decisions.reason: The modular mobile processing concept builds on the firm's core recycling know-how, and the customer reports more than 600,000 euros saved per year, a result the firm can interpret and build on with its own R&D.
The mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established offer and has had its own page for two consecutive years, so the firm has the related knowledge to refine it.
This MMAK concept is backed by a specific customer reference and quantified savings, and it fits the firm's strategy of modular solutions that its R&D and university cooperation can extend.
The newly launched slow-speed shredders are close to the core business and have a page of their own, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve them.

The mobile spiral shaft screens extend the firm's screening know-how and were recently launched with their own page, so they warrant time to learn from market results despite the earlier drop of the trommel screen.
